player_prompt.intro:
Kuna wasa {color} a wasan Breakthrough. Kuna motsa {direction} a kan allo na {board_size}x{board_size}.
A lokacin da kuke motsa, kuna iya motsa wani kaya guda daya tafiyar gaba ko kuma a diagonal gaba.
Wani kaya na iya motsa a diagonal idan akwai kaya na abokin hamayya a can, kuma motsa a diagonal kadai ne kaya zasu iya shiga muraba da kaya na abokin hamayya.
Idan kuka shiga muraba da kaya na abokin hamayya, kuka kama shi kuma kaya na abokin hamayya zasu ɓace daga allo.
Ku yi amfani da alama kama UCI a cikin mabano, misali [a2a3] don motsa daga a2 zuwa a3.
* 'a' yana nuna safu ta hagu, '1' ita ce safu ta ƙasa (daga hangen Fari).
* Safu ta gida ta Baƙi ita ce safu ta sama (safu ta 8 don allo na 8x8). Safu ta gida ta Fari ita ce safu ta ƙasa (safu ta 1 don allo na 8x8).
Dan wasa na farko wanda kaya nasa ta kai safu ta gida ta abokin hamayya zai yi nasara. Idan duk kayan ku an kama su, kuka yi rashin nasara.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Da fatan za a yi amfani da alamun algebraic na bracketed kamar [a2a3].
invalid_move.illegal: Wannan motsi ba ya bin ka'idojin Breakthrough ko kuma ba kayan aikinka ba ne.

outcome.white_reached: Fari ya kai safu ta gida ta Baƙi.
outcome.black_reached: Baƙi ya kai safu ta gida ta Fari.
outcome.no_moves: Mai kunnawa {player_id} ba shi da ƙarin motsawa.
